fit_reason: Makes the lasers (EMLs, CW lasers, VCSELs), transceivers, ROADMs and optical components that carry AI traffic beyond the rack. Optical communications is central to its business, and lasers are needed by every optical design including co-packaged optics, making it one of the purest and most important optical plays.

Makes lasers, optical components and datacom transceivers, and is a leading supplier of optical modules for data center scale-out and scale-across links. Optical communications for data centers is now a major driver of the business, alongside industrial lasers, and it is a core laser and transceiver supplier to the AI buildout.

Supplies the optical DSPs, laser drivers, TIAs, silicon photonics and co-packaged optics engines used in pluggable and CPO links, plus Ethernet switches and active electrical cable DSPs. It also develops UALink and scale-up switches, so it spans optical, switching and scale-up and data center interconnect is core to its business.

Designs the high-performance Ethernet switching and routing platforms that hyperscalers use for AI scale-out back-end networks. Networking is the whole business, and it is one of the leading Ethernet switch vendors in AI clusters.

Makes SerDes, DSPs, optical DSPs and active electrical cables, which are the copper links inside the rack and short-reach connections that the guidance calls the existing base case. High-speed connectivity for AI data centers is the entire business, with direct hyperscaler exposure.

Sells the merchant Ethernet switch silicon (Tomahawk, Jericho), SerDes, optical DSPs and co-packaged optics that underpin scale-out and scale-across networks. Networking is a large part of its AI semiconductor revenue but sits alongside custom accelerators, software and wireless, so it is a meaningful rather than sole part of the business.

Leader in coherent optical transport and packet-optical systems, which connect data centers to each other (scale across) and data center interconnect. Optical networking equipment is its whole business and demand from cloud and AI operators is a key driver.

Contract manufacturer of optical packaging and transceivers, active optical cables, lasers and other optical modules, with a large share of its output going to optical communications customers such as Nvidia. It benefits from volume growth in optical links, with optical manufacturing central to the business.

Supplies PCIe and CXL retimers, smart cable modules and fabric switches that connect accelerators, memory and networking within AI racks (scale-up). Connectivity for AI infrastructure is its whole business, though it is a smaller company with high customer concentration.

Makes optical fiber, cable, cable assemblies and connectivity hardware that physically carry optical links inside and between data centers. Optical communications is its largest segment and is growing with AI, but display, specialty materials, automotive and life sciences remain a large part of the company.

Sells NVLink for scale-up, plus InfiniBand and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking (from Mellanox) for scale-out, so it sets the standard for much of the network between accelerators. Networking is a large and fast-growing but minority part of a business dominated by GPUs.

Makes lasers, optical transceivers and modules for data center operators and cable/telecom equipment makers. Optical networking is the entire business and it benefits from higher-speed transceiver demand, though it is a smaller supplier with customer concentration.

Makes indium phosphide and gallium arsenide substrates that are the starting material for lasers, VCSELs and photonic chips used in data center optics. This is a key upstream input to every laser-based optical link, but the business also serves other end markets such as sensing and LEDs.

Largest networking vendor, selling data center and enterprise switching, routing, silicon, optics (including from Acacia) and AI networking systems. Networking is the core business, but its large enterprise and campus base means AI data center exposure is only part of the story.

Makes high-speed connectors, backplane interconnects, cable assemblies and fiber optic connectors, including the copper cabling used for short reach links and rack-level scale-up. Information technology and data communication is a large and fast-growing market for it, but it is a diversified connector company serving many other end markets.

Electronics manufacturer that builds and designs data center switches, routers and interconnect systems for hyperscalers, including 800G Ethernet switches. Its Connectivity & Cloud Solutions segment is the growth driver, but it also does lower-growth work for other industries.

Supplies analog semiconductors for optical networking, including laser drivers, TIAs and photodiodes used in data center optical modules. Data center is a growing part of the business but telecom, industrial and defense still make up much of it.

World's largest connector and sensor maker, supplying cable assemblies, high-speed connectors and fiber optic products for data centers and AI servers. Data center and AI is a growing and meaningful part of the business, which is mostly automotive and industrial.

Sells Aruba campus networking and, with the Juniper acquisition, routing, switching and AI data center Ethernet fabrics, alongside servers and storage. Networking is now a meaningful part of the business but servers and enterprise IT remain the larger share.

Provides IP routing, optical transport (coherent transponders, WDM, ROADM, data center interconnect) and fixed access for telecom operators and hyperscalers. Network infrastructure is the core of its business, but mobile networks and telecom operator spending remain a large portion.

Makes analog and mixed-signal chips including signal integrity and optical drivers for data center interconnects and passive optical networks. Data center optical links are a growing part of its business alongside industrial and consumer products.

Supplies optical DSPs and networking chips used in optical transceivers and data center interconnect, along with broadband, wireless and cable infrastructure silicon. The optical and data center piece is a meaningful growth driver but the company is mostly broadband and wireless today.

Formerly CommScope, it makes fiber and copper cabling, connectivity and enclosures for data centers and telecom networks, plus indoor cellular and access network equipment. Data center connectivity is a meaningful part but broadband, cable access and enterprise networking make up much of the business.

Makes copper and fiber cabling, connectivity and industrial Ethernet switches and networking equipment for enterprise and industrial networks. Data center cabling is only one part of its enterprise segment, with industrial automation networking a large share.

Largest North American printed circuit board maker, supplying the complex boards used in data center switches and servers along with aerospace and defense. Data center computing is a growing but minority part of a diversified PCB business.

Operates a long-haul fiber network and sells wavelength, dark fiber and private connectivity services, including to hyperscalers connecting data centers (scale across). Fiber infrastructure for AI traffic is a meaningful growth angle, but the business is still mostly legacy enterprise and consumer telecom.

Sells wired and wireless network infrastructure including Ethernet switches and cloud network management software. Networking is the whole business, but it focuses on enterprise campus rather than AI data center back-end fabrics, so it is a peripheral player in AI networking.

Electronics manufacturer producing PCBs, backplanes, cable assemblies, enclosures and optical and RF modules, with cloud and communications customers. Networking and cloud infrastructure is a meaningful part of its diversified manufacturing business.

Makes network test, monitoring and fiber optic test equipment used to build and verify optical networks, including data center fiber links. Test gear benefits from more optical deployment, but it is not on the data path itself and the business also covers telecom service assurance and optical security products.

Global contract manufacturer serving cloud infrastructure, networking and data storage customers with PCB assembly, enclosures and systems integration. Networking is a small part of a very diversified manufacturing business, so this is a borderline fit.

Makes fiber and diode lasers and fiber amplifiers, plus some optical transceiver modules for data center networking. Mostly an industrial materials-processing laser company, so the networking link is thin and this is a borderline fit.
Makes interconnect, power and circuit protection components for data infrastructure and other end markets. The description is thin, so networking relevance is unclear, and this is a borderline fit.

Makes test and measurement instruments for high-speed data center networking and optical components, such as oscilloscopes, BERTs and network test platforms. It is a tools supplier to the networking industry rather than a company moving data, so this is a borderline fit.
